test_llama4_ref: test the Llama4 MoE model against HF reference, grouped GEMM, and Triton implementations with forward and backward pass verification
test_llama4_ref_overlap_router_shared: test the Llama4 MoE model with overlap_router_shared enabled to validate shared router weights in grouped GEMM and Triton kernels
test_llama4_ref_permute_y: test the Llama4 MoE model with permute_y enabled to validate tensor permutation in Triton grouped GEMM kernels
test_llama4_ref_autotune: test the Llama4 MoE model with autotuning enabled to validate Triton kernel autotuning for grouped GEMM operations
test_llama4_ref_backward: test the Llama4 MoE model backward pass to verify gradient computation matches HF reference for grouped GEMM and Triton implementations
